title: Readiness Probes Are
subtitle: Readiness decides who gets new traffic; it is not a verdict on service health

panels.heading: Pod Turns Unready
panels.caption: The readiness probe fails; kubelet flips the Pod's Ready condition to false
panels.note: The container is not restarted and existing connections are not cut

panels.heading: Routing Changes
panels.caption: The endpoint stays in the EndpointSlice with ready=false; kube-proxy stops sending new requests
panels.note: ClusterIP DNS does not change; readiness only shifts new traffic between Pods

panels.heading: Health Is Elsewhere
panels.caption: Users can still fail while every Pod reports Ready
panels.note: Over-scoped probes flap whole fleets; shallow probes admit broken instances

strip_title: Use readiness as a routing valve
strip_caption: Keep probes local and bounded, and measure real health from the outside in
